The table lists every atom of one conventional cubic cell of sodalite (Na8Al6Si6O24Cl2, COD 1000028). Use the kinematic structure factor with atomic numbers as angle-independent weights and first-order Bragg diffraction; the relevant peak is the lowest-angle reflection with non-zero intensity. Weights: Al = 13, Cl = 17, Na = 11, O = 8, Si = 14. You must choose the X-ray source line that places this lowest-angle reflection with non-zero intensity closest to 2θ = 6.60° (for example, to keep it clear of the beam stop while resolving it well). Which line should you choose?

选项：
A. Co Kα1 (λ = 1.78897 Å)
B. Mo Kα1 (λ = 0.70930 Å)
C. Cr Kα1 (λ = 2.28970 Å)
D. Cu Kα1 (λ = 1.54056 Å)
